Hi Monica / Samir,

Thanks for the context. Quick summary of Redwood’s procurement posture:
- Standard rule: PO required for vendors that will invoice Redwood (AP) or where recurring invoices exceed $1,000/month or $12,000/year.
- For card-billed SaaS subscriptions, we allow onboarding without a PO if the expected annual spend is under $5,000 and Finance can reconcile monthly statements.

Options for InfraMart based on what you’ve shared:
1) Card-first onboarding (no PO): allowed if InfraMart confirms they will accept card payments and expected annual spend stays < $5k. Procurement needs the onboarding form + W-9 (received) and a signed vendor agreement or terms.
2) Formal PO: if InfraMart prefers invoicing or annualizes the agreement above the thresholds, we’ll require a vendor record and PO — this adds a 7–10 business day vendor setup.

To proceed with an exception (option 1), please complete the PO Exception Request form: https://drive.google.com/file/d/po_exception_request_form (I’ve attached a doc copy: po_exception_request_form.docx). We’ll need:
- Business justification (pilot, short-term evaluation)
- Expected monthly and annual spend estimate
- Sales/Revenue owner approval (Marissa is looped)

Samir — can you confirm expected monthly spend for the pilot and whether InfraMart will accept card payment? Also confirm the billing contact for reconciliation.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference

(attachment: po_exception_request_form.docx)

Looping in from Sales. Monica — InfraMart is a priority pilot; we’re comfortable approving a limited no-PO onboarding for up to 6 months with these conditions:
- Cap the pilot at $6,000 annualized (approximately $500/month)
- InfraMart pays by corporate card and provides monthly receipts to Finance
- Auto-review after 6 months for conversion to a standard PO/contract

HubSpot deal: INFRA-2026-PILOT (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/567890/INFRA-2026-PILOT). Monica, please note in the exception form that Sales has approved the pilot and the 6-month review requirement.

—Marissa

All — based on Sales sign-off and the onboarding docs from InfraMart, Procurement approves a timeboxed PO exception with the following conditions:
- Exception duration: 6 months from onboarding date; Procurement will trigger the review 2 weeks before expiration.
- Spend cap: $6,000/year; Finance will reconcile monthly.
- Vendor record will be created in Nexus; InfraMart must accept card payments and provide receipts to finance@redwood.com.
- This approval is contingent on receiving a signed vendor terms acknowledgment (we can accept the onboarding form + email confirmation for the pilot).

I’ve attached the signed exception approval for records: approved_po_exception.pdf. Monica, please confirm and I’ll instruct Vendor Ops to create the record and finalize setup.
